_views.text: Ambient_System is always on. It is the first signal a non-visual user receives when opening the application. Two oscillator layers run continuously and change with Nucleus state: actif plays a warm 639 Hz sine pulsing at 1 Hz with a gentle 741 Hz shimmer — the system breathes. Latent drops to 432 Hz at barely perceptible amplitude, pulsing at 0.3 Hz — deep rest. Instable switches to sawtooth at 417 Hz pulsing at 4.5 Hz with a dissonant 852 Hz square shimmer — chaos is unmistakable. No visual required. No text required. The state is in the air.
